# AARP Content Recommendations — Unified personalization on Palantir Foundry

Generated July 26, 2026 — Sales Brief

AARP — A Blend360 Case Study

## Executive Summary

AARP partnered with Blend360 to replace four independent recommendation systems with a unified ensemble engine for articles, events, offers, and actions on Palantir Foundry. The platform improved click-through and conversion performance, reduced operating cost, and served recommendations at large scale with sub-300-millisecond delivery. ([AARP Branded long form _201_Non-Profit_Data Science & Insights_Customer Experience_Content Recommendation Engine on Palantir Foundry.pptx])

## The Challenge

Four siloed ALS-based systems created fragmented member experiences, duplicated maintenance, high compute cost, and limited cross-channel insight. The new system also needed to satisfy a sub-700-millisecond endpoint requirement across millions of users and items. ([AARP Branded long form _201_Non-Profit_Data Science & Insights_Customer Experience_Content Recommendation Engine on Palantir Foundry.pptx])

## Our Solution

Blend360 delivered a cohesive recommendation engine with ensemble retrieval, lifecycle-specific training windows, a consolidated feature store, smart pre-filtering, batch scoring, and real-time serving on Palantir Foundry. ([AARP Branded long form _201_Non-Profit_Data Science & Insights_Customer Experience_Content Recommendation Engine on Palantir Foundry.pptx])

## Key Features

- **Unified ensemble engine** — Replaced separate article, event, offer, and action models. ([AARP Branded long form _201_Non-Profit_Data Science & Insights_Customer Experience_Content Recommendation Engine on Palantir Foundry.pptx])
- **Lifecycle personalization** — Used distinct pipelines and training windows for users at different engagement stages. ([AARP Branded long form _201_Non-Profit_Data Science & Insights_Customer Experience_Content Recommendation Engine on Palantir Foundry.pptx])
